latest_articles.title: This Taiwanese Biotech Is Building a Nanorocket Inside the Human Body
latest_articles.summary: Oligonucleotide therapeutics are moving from sequence design to extrahepatic delivery. Intelligene is using EV and LNP platforms to target the lung and airways, testing whether RNA medicines can truly reach disease sites beyond the liver.

latest_articles.title: 這家台灣Biotech正在打造人體內奈米火箭
latest_articles.summary: 小核酸藥物的競爭正從 RNA 序列設計走向肝外遞送；智新生技以 EV 與 LNP 平台切入肺部與呼吸道，挑戰小核酸下半場最值錢的問題：能否真正抵達病灶。

latest_articles.title: Novo Nordisk’s 6,300-Patient ZEUS Failure: A Textbook Lesson in Translational Risk
latest_articles.summary: ZEUS showed the central translational risk in cardiovascular drug development: ziltivekimab suppressed the IL-6 pathway, but the 6,300-patient outcomes trial did not reduce three-point MACE.

latest_articles.title: 諾和諾德大三期慘敗！6,300 人的教科書級教訓
latest_articles.summary: ZEUS 超過 6,300 人卻交出 HR 0.99：ziltivekimab 壓低 free IL-6 與 hsCRP，卻沒有證明能降低三點 MACE。這不是抗發炎假說死亡，而是 biomarker 不能替患者硬終點預支成功。

latest_articles.title: Can $1.2 Billion Help AI Double the Pace of Drug R&D?
latest_articles.summary: The Bio Genesis Mission is an attempt to connect supercomputing, biomedical data, AI agents, automated laboratories, clinical networks, and regulation into one R&D loop. Its real test is whether governed data and reproducible experiments can reach patients faster.

latest_articles.title: 美國砸 12 億美元，想用 AI 把新藥研發快一倍！
latest_articles.summary: 美國以 Bio Genesis Mission 串起超算、生醫資料、AI 代理、自動化實驗、臨床與監管能力；真正的成敗不在模型口號，而在資料治理、實驗重現與患者轉譯能否形成閉環。

latest_articles.title: After 20 Years, Have HDAC Inhibitors Finally Found Their Role? Why ABT-301 Could Become a Next-Generation Combination Backbone
latest_articles.summary: Chidamide has brought HDAC inhibition back into solid-tumor development. ABT-301 must now show that a wider therapeutic window, triplet combinability, and human immune-mechanism data can support a next-generation combination backbone.

latest_articles.title: 20年後，HDAC抑制劑終於找到真正的位置？ABT-301能否成為下一代聯合治療骨幹
latest_articles.summary: Chidamide以pMMR大腸癌44% ORR與黑色素瘤第三期PFS達標，重新降低HDAC抑制劑的類別風險；安邦ABT-301接下來必須用治療窗口、三聯可組合性與人體免疫機轉，證明資產差異。

latest_articles.title: 禮來領頭，大藥廠半年豪砸 1,300 億美元搶時間！
latest_articles.summary: 2026 年上半年生技製藥併購總額約 1,300 億美元，買家偏向臨床後期與接近上市的資產。這一輪不是全面牛市，而是大藥廠在專利懸崖前，用交易結構與現金購買可計算的開發時間。

latest_articles.title: $130 Billion in Six Months: Big Pharma Is Buying Time
latest_articles.summary: Biopharma M&A reached approximately $130 billion in the first half of 2026 as buyers favored late-stage and near-launch assets. This is not a broad biotech bull market; it is Big Pharma using cash and contingent deal structures to buy measurable development time before the patent cliff.

latest_articles.title: J&J's Oral Psoriasis Drug Logged 18,000 Prescriptions in Its First Full Quarter. Is It Coming for Injectables?
latest_articles.summary: ICOTYDE logged more than 18,000 prescriptions in its first full quarter. The oral IL-23R peptide has earned entry into the high-efficacy psoriasis market, but durable value still depends on paid fills, persistence, payer quality, safety, and additional indications.

latest_articles.title: 嬌生口服藥首季 1.8 萬張處方，針劑飯碗要被搶了？
latest_articles.summary: ICOTYDE 上市後第一個完整季度累積逾 18,000 張處方。口服 IL-23R 胜肽已取得進入高療效市場的資格，真正的商業答案仍取決於續方、支付品質、長期留存與多適應症。

latest_articles.title: Why These Four Biotechs Can Afford Not to Sell
latest_articles.summary: argenx, Insmed, Incyte, and Revolution Medicines show why biotech independence depends on product evidence, cash generation, a second growth curve, global execution, and financing without surrendering control.

latest_articles.title: 不賣給大藥廠，4 家生技公司憑什麼自己做大？
latest_articles.summary: argenx、Insmed、Incyte 與 Revolution Medicines 選擇保留獨立經營權。真正的不賣資格，來自產品證據、現金引擎、第二曲線、全球執行與不交出控制權也能取得資金的能力。

latest_articles.title: 22 億美元，買下一個自體免疫藥王？
latest_articles.summary: argenx 擬以 22 億美元現金收購 Forte，把早期抗 CD122 抗體 FB102 納入管線。真正的考題不是一組一期 p 值，而是 VYVGART 的單品成功能否被複製成可重複的公司能力。

latest_articles.title: $2.2 Billion for the Next Autoimmune Blockbuster?
latest_articles.summary: argenx plans to pay $2.2 billion in cash for Forte and its early anti-CD122 antibody FB102. The real test is not one Phase 1b p-value, but whether VYVGART's product success reflects a development engine the company can repeat.

latest_articles.title: Investors, Take Note: Hair Loss Could Be Biotech's Next Weight-Loss-Drug-Sized Blockbuster
latest_articles.summary: Lilly has placed a $40 million bet on next-generation hair-loss drugs. With roughly 80 million U.S. patients still constrained by two legacy therapies, AH-001's Phase 2 data could become the next global asset-revaluation trigger.

latest_articles.title: 投資人請注意，下一個減肥藥級別賽道來了！
latest_articles.summary: 禮來用 4,000 萬美元卡位掉髮新藥；當美國約 8,000 萬名患者仍受限於兩款老藥，安宏 AH-001 的二期數據可能成為下一次全球資產重估關鍵。

latest_articles.title: More Than $1 Billion in One Quarter: Why Did Alnylam Plunge 28%?
latest_articles.summary: Amvuttra surpassed $1 billion in quarterly sales, yet Alnylam cut its TTR guidance and lost 28% in one day. The reset was not about RNAi technology failing; it was about pent-up demand normalizing, revenue concentration and the timing gap before a second commercial pillar arrives.

latest_articles.title: 一季賣破 10 億，Alnylam 為何崩 28%？
latest_articles.summary: Amvuttra 單季銷售突破 10 億美元，Alnylam 卻下修 TTR 指引並重挫 28%。真正被重估的不是 RNAi 技術，而是積壓需求退潮、收入集中與下一個商業支柱的時間差。

latest_articles.title: A $400 Billion Pharma Merger? AstraZeneca and Bristol Myers Squibb Are Reportedly Talking
latest_articles.summary: AstraZeneca and BMS reportedly explored a combination with a combined market value approaching $400 billion. There is no announced transaction. The real questions are AstraZeneca's 2030 growth target, BMS's Eliquis and Opdivo exclusivity timeline, oncology-pipeline overlap, antitrust and whether integration can actually buy time.

latest_articles.title: 超級大藥廠 4,000 億美元合併？阿斯特捷利康＋BMS！
latest_articles.summary: Financial Times 報導 AstraZeneca 與 BMS 曾探討結合，合計市值接近 4,000 億美元。這不是已簽交易；真正的產業問題是 2030 成長、Eliquis／Opdivo 獨占期、腫瘤管線重疊、反壟斷與整合能否買到時間。

latest_articles.title: Tau Earned a Retest: Why Biogen Is Taking Diranersen Into Phase 3 After CELIA Missed Its Primary Endpoint
latest_articles.summary: CELIA missed its prespecified dose-response primary endpoint, yet the lowest dose produced a 0.54-point CDR-SB difference, or 26% slowing, while CSF total tau and tau PET moved in the expected direction. That is enough to justify Phase 3 planning, but not enough to declare tau a validated second disease-modifying pathway.

latest_articles.title: Tau 拿到補考資格：Diranersen 主終點失敗，為什麼 Biogen 仍要進三期？
latest_articles.summary: CELIA 未達預設劑量反應主要終點，最低劑量卻在 CDR-SB 看到 26% 惡化減緩，CSF total tau 與 Tau PET 也同向下降。這些訊號足以讓 Biogen 與 Ionis 規劃三期，還不足以宣布 Tau 已成為第二條獲確認的疾病修飾路線。

latest_articles.title: Bempikibart in Alopecia Areata: A 33-Patient Signal Is Not Yet a Win Over JAK Inhibitors
latest_articles.summary: Q32 Bio nearly doubled after a 33-patient, single-arm Phase 2a readout. The investable questions are whether efficacy survives randomization, whether responses persist after treatment stops, and whether a larger safety database can support a differentiated place beside JAK inhibitors.

latest_articles.title: 鬼剃頭新藥，先別封神
latest_articles.summary: 33 人、單臂、開放標籤的 Phase 2a 資料讓 Q32 Bio 股價近乎翻倍；真正的問題是療效能否重現、停藥後能否維持，以及安全性是否足以改變 JAK 抑制劑的臨床位置。

latest_articles.title: AnBogen Therapeutics: Building a “Starlink” for Cancer Immunotherapy
latest_articles.summary: Can a small molecule from Taiwan extend the $30 billion PD-1 ecosystem into the 95% of metastatic colorectal cancer patients still beyond immunotherapy’s reach?

latest_articles.summary: 一顆台灣小分子，有機會把三百億美元級PD-1藥王送進九成五患者仍無法受益的治療盲區嗎？

latest_articles.title: Xtandi 之後，安斯泰來靠誰？從單一明星藥到腫瘤平台的四道驗證門
latest_articles.summary: Xtandi 仍主導安斯泰來腫瘤收入；Padcev、Vyloy 與下一代 CLDN18.2 資產能否在 LOE 後形成可重複的產品平台，才是下一段考題。

latest_articles.title: After Xtandi: Can Astellas Build an Oncology Platform?
latest_articles.summary: Xtandi still dominates Astellas oncology sales. The real test is whether Padcev, Vyloy and the next CLDN18.2 assets can become a repeatable post-LOE platform.

market_attention_signals.summary: Oligonucleotide therapeutics are moving from sequence design to extrahepatic delivery. Intelligene is using EV and LNP platforms to target the lung and airways, testing whether RNA medicines can truly reach disease sites beyond the liver.

market_attention_signals.title: Novo Nordisk’s 6,300-Patient ZEUS Failure: A Textbook Lesson in Translational Risk
market_attention_signals.summary: ZEUS showed the central translational risk in cardiovascular drug development: ziltivekimab suppressed the IL-6 pathway, but the 6,300-patient outcomes trial did not reduce three-point MACE.

market_attention_signals.title: Can $1.2 Billion Help AI Double the Pace of Drug R&D?
market_attention_signals.summary: The Bio Genesis Mission is an attempt to connect supercomputing, biomedical data, AI agents, automated laboratories, clinical networks, and regulation into one R&D loop. Its real test is whether governed data and reproducible experiments can reach patients faster.

market_attention_signals.title: 美國砸 12 億美元，想用 AI 把新藥研發快一倍！
market_attention_signals.summary: 美國以 Bio Genesis Mission 串起超算、生醫資料、AI 代理、自動化實驗、臨床與監管能力；真正的成敗不在模型口號，而在資料治理、實驗重現與患者轉譯能否形成閉環。

market_attention_signals.title: After 20 Years, Have HDAC Inhibitors Finally Found Their Role? Why ABT-301 Could Become a Next-Generation Combination Backbone
market_attention_signals.summary: Chidamide has brought HDAC inhibition back into solid-tumor development. ABT-301 must now show that a wider therapeutic window, triplet combinability, and human immune-mechanism data can support a next-generation combination backbone.

market_attention_signals.title: 禮來領頭，大藥廠半年豪砸 1,300 億美元搶時間！
market_attention_signals.summary: 2026 年上半年生技製藥併購總額約 1,300 億美元，買家偏向臨床後期與接近上市的資產。這一輪不是全面牛市，而是大藥廠在專利懸崖前，用交易結構與現金購買可計算的開發時間。

market_attention_signals.title: $130 Billion in Six Months: Big Pharma Is Buying Time
market_attention_signals.summary: Biopharma M&A reached approximately $130 billion in the first half of 2026 as buyers favored late-stage and near-launch assets. This is not a broad biotech bull market; it is Big Pharma using cash and contingent deal structures to buy measurable development time before the patent cliff.

market_attention_signals.title: J&J's Oral Psoriasis Drug Logged 18,000 Prescriptions in Its First Full Quarter. Is It Coming for Injectables?
market_attention_signals.summary: ICOTYDE logged more than 18,000 prescriptions in its first full quarter. The oral IL-23R peptide has earned entry into the high-efficacy psoriasis market, but durable value still depends on paid fills, persistence, payer quality, safety, and additional indications.

market_attention_signals.title: $2.2 Billion for the Next Autoimmune Blockbuster?
market_attention_signals.summary: argenx plans to pay $2.2 billion in cash for Forte and its early anti-CD122 antibody FB102. The real test is not one Phase 1b p-value, but whether VYVGART's product success reflects a development engine the company can repeat.

market_attention_signals.title: Investors, Take Note: Hair Loss Could Be Biotech's Next Weight-Loss-Drug-Sized Blockbuster
market_attention_signals.summary: Lilly has placed a $40 million bet on next-generation hair-loss drugs. With roughly 80 million U.S. patients still constrained by two legacy therapies, AH-001's Phase 2 data could become the next global asset-revaluation trigger.

market_attention_signals.title: More Than $1 Billion in One Quarter: Why Did Alnylam Plunge 28%?
market_attention_signals.summary: Amvuttra surpassed $1 billion in quarterly sales, yet Alnylam cut its TTR guidance and lost 28% in one day. The reset was not about RNAi technology failing; it was about pent-up demand normalizing, revenue concentration and the timing gap before a second commercial pillar arrives.

market_attention_signals.title: 一季賣破 10 億，Alnylam 為何崩 28%？
market_attention_signals.summary: Amvuttra 單季銷售突破 10 億美元，Alnylam 卻下修 TTR 指引並重挫 28%。真正被重估的不是 RNAi 技術，而是積壓需求退潮、收入集中與下一個商業支柱的時間差。

market_attention_signals.title: 超級大藥廠 4,000 億美元合併？阿斯特捷利康＋BMS！
market_attention_signals.summary: Financial Times 報導 AstraZeneca 與 BMS 曾探討結合，合計市值接近 4,000 億美元。這不是已簽交易；真正的產業問題是 2030 成長、Eliquis／Opdivo 獨占期、腫瘤管線重疊、反壟斷與整合能否買到時間。

market_attention_signals.title: Tau Earned a Retest: Why Biogen Is Taking Diranersen Into Phase 3 After CELIA Missed Its Primary Endpoint
market_attention_signals.summary: CELIA missed its prespecified dose-response primary endpoint, yet the lowest dose produced a 0.54-point CDR-SB difference, or 26% slowing, while CSF total tau and tau PET moved in the expected direction. That is enough to justify Phase 3 planning, but not enough to declare tau a validated second disease-modifying pathway.

market_attention_signals.title: Tau 拿到補考資格：Diranersen 主終點失敗，為什麼 Biogen 仍要進三期？
market_attention_signals.summary: CELIA 未達預設劑量反應主要終點，最低劑量卻在 CDR-SB 看到 26% 惡化減緩，CSF total tau 與 Tau PET 也同向下降。這些訊號足以讓 Biogen 與 Ionis 規劃三期，還不足以宣布 Tau 已成為第二條獲確認的疾病修飾路線。

market_attention_signals.title: Bempikibart in Alopecia Areata: A 33-Patient Signal Is Not Yet a Win Over JAK Inhibitors
market_attention_signals.summary: Q32 Bio nearly doubled after a 33-patient, single-arm Phase 2a readout. The investable questions are whether efficacy survives randomization, whether responses persist after treatment stops, and whether a larger safety database can support a differentiated place beside JAK inhibitors.

market_attention_signals.title: 鬼剃頭新藥，先別封神
market_attention_signals.summary: 33 人、單臂、開放標籤的 Phase 2a 資料讓 Q32 Bio 股價近乎翻倍；真正的問題是療效能否重現、停藥後能否維持，以及安全性是否足以改變 JAK 抑制劑的臨床位置。

market_attention_signals.title: AnBogen Therapeutics: Building a “Starlink” for Cancer Immunotherapy

market_attention_signals.title: T-cell Exhaustion Across PD-1, CAR-T and TCE: Immunotherapy's Next Contest Is Durability
market_attention_signals.summary: PD-1 blockade, CAR-T and T-cell engagers ultimately depend on T cells that can expand, renew and persist. This analysis connects exhaustion biology, product engineering and clinical evidence to the next competitive threshold in immunotherapy.

market_attention_signals.title: 半年千億，買的是時間
market_attention_signals.summary: 2026 上半年生醫併購轉熱，但 BioSpace 的 52 筆與 IQVIA 的 42 筆不能硬拼。真正的主線，是專利懸崖迫使大藥廠用現金購買可計算的臨床時間。

market_attention_signals.title: $130 Billion in Six Months: Big Pharma Is Buying Time
market_attention_signals.summary: Biopharma M&A accelerated in the first half of 2026, but BioSpace's 52 deals and IQVIA's 42 deals cannot be combined. The deeper story is that patent cliffs are pushing Big Pharma to pay for measurable clinical time.

market_attention_signals.title: Roche's Hidden Succession Engine: How 19 New Molecules Could Power the Next Growth Cycle
market_attention_signals.summary: Roche generated CHF 47.669 billion in pharmaceutical sales in 2025, with Ocrevus, Hemlibra, and Vabysmo already accounting for roughly one-third of the total. The number that matters is not simply 19 potential new molecules, but whether giredestrant, fenebrutinib, obesity, Alzheimer's, and protein-degradation assets can inherit Roche's existing clinical, diagnostic, and commercial infrastructure on time.

market_attention_signals.title: 羅氏的隱藏底牌：19 個新分子排隊接棒，下一個成長週期怎麼長出來？
market_attention_signals.summary: 羅氏 2025 年製藥銷售 476.69 億瑞士法郎，Ocrevus、Hemlibra 與 Vabysmo 已撐起約三分之一收入。真正值得追的不是 19 個新分子的總數，而是 giredestrant、fenebrutinib、減重、阿茲海默症與蛋白質降解資產能否沿既有臨床、診斷與商業通路準時接棒。

market_attention_signals.title: SpaceX Goes to Orbit. Is the Money in the Crystals?
market_attention_signals.summary: SpaceX is making low-Earth-orbit round trips more routine, but rockets do not discover drugs. From Keytruda crystallization and SpaceMD to Varda, UK regulation, and a Taiwan mission, this analysis asks whether microgravity-enabled manufacturing can pass the tests of repetition, scale-up, and regulation.

market_attention_signals.title: When a Biotech Says No to a Sale: Five Tests of Whether It Can Become a Biopharma
market_attention_signals.summary: An acquisition is not the only successful outcome for a biotech. Using argenx, Insmed, Incyte, and Revolution Medicines as four operating snapshots, this analysis tests product evidence, cash generation, a second growth curve, global execution, and financing options—and shows what retaining control really costs.

market_attention_signals.title: Biotech 不賣，憑什麼？五張門票決定它能否長成 Biopharma
market_attention_signals.summary: 被收購不是 Biotech 唯一的成功終點。本文以 argenx、Insmed、Incyte 與 Revolution Medicines 為四個截面，檢驗產品證據、現金引擎、第二曲線、全球執行與融資選項，並拆解保留控制權的真實成本。

market_attention_signals.title: Madrigal's MASH Platform Strategy: Rezdiffra as the Cornerstone, siRNA as the Next Growth Engine
market_attention_signals.summary: Rezdiffra has opened the MASH market and built its commercialization infrastructure. Madrigal is now adding six Ribo siRNA programs and Arrowhead's ARO-PNPLA3 to create a cornerstone-plus-precision-combination treatment matrix.

market_attention_signals.title: 聯手巨頭卡位 MASH：Madrigal 把 Rezdiffra 做成基石藥，小核酸開始接棒
market_attention_signals.summary: Rezdiffra 已把 MASH 市場與商業化基礎設施打開；Madrigal 再以 Ribo 六條 siRNA 管線與 Arrowhead ARO-PNPLA3，建立基石藥加精準聯用矩陣。

market_attention_signals.title: Animal Studies Are Not Disappearing. Drug Development Rules Are Changing.
market_attention_signals.summary: China's CDE PIONEER program opens a regulatory pathway for new approach methodologies. The real test is whether human-relevant evidence becomes reproducible, validated and reusable.

market_attention_signals.title: 動物實驗不是消失，而是藥物研發規則開始換代
market_attention_signals.summary: CDE 的 NAMs 先鋒計畫為藥企與方法開發者開出雙軌入口；真正的考題是可重複、可驗證且被監管接受的人體相關證據。
